body:
PR924 leaves optimality under its 32-macro allowance open. This **scoped negative result** establishes that its existing 73-real-primitive circuit attains the exact minimum for signed dyadic diagonal gauges of the fixed 26 ordered ADDs. **No new kappa.**

The complete domain has 39,424 magnitude-scale placements and 315,392 tuples including sign-only placement. There is one optimal magnitude placement and eight sign ties. A separate implementation emits and executes all 39,424 primitive streams on nine exact input columns and reproduces the complete cost histogram. All eight optimal sign placements also pass the pinned PR696 lowering in four orientations against both PR681 and PR924.

The package proves why arbitrary gauges at the minimum macro count reduce to this finite domain. It also excludes extra macros under the retained local invoice: one costs 414,949,376, while all fourteen windows and fourteen inverse cleanups together spend only 4,088 real primitives. This includes nonuniform choices across windows. The claim fixes the ordered ADD topology, lowering, adapter formula and outside work; it is not a global circuit or compiler lower bound.

Reproduce offline with Python 3.9+:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/complex-factory-scale-frontier27/check.py
```

Expected: `PASS_FACTORY_SCALE_PACKAGE complete=315392 exact_matrix_replays=39424 minimum=73 winners=8 no_new_kappa`.

Validation: complete package on CPython 3.14.6 and 3.9.6/macOS with isolated optimized execution; 12 test groups including 64 gate mutations, exact-halving and dirty-work controls, minimal offline relocation, source/receipt corruption and output preservation; `make selected-record-check`; staged whitespace check. The final inventory-binding tightening was followed by another primary replay and package-test run. No full repository/cold supplier replay, global invoice/assembly, Lean or hosted CI is claimed.

Base: **47481c89fd30a43f8f882eb4b391e89c29273fd0**. Contribution commit: **102ddfb47d11c8ad66121350907d4a2cc04cea8c**. Assignment seed **27**, complex-supplier track. Refreshed main `007664306fff84fbb1c9a1b4053b69f439764034` preserves the consumed sources and selected conditional kappa **0.001661957774647029**. Only the new research package is added; selected and upstream files are untouched.

Pending source pins: PR922 `efd5643c0016b6c6dac26e9ed7dee8a75295ff2a`, PR924 `d02d83332581f6a23616c1366c6b3901d42f4b06`. The retained PR924 composition JSON is byte-identical; no pending executable code is imported. The refreshed inventory through #948 found no duplicate of this complete 26-ADD census. There is no pinned coordination issue; the local claim records scope, alternatives, result and review link.

Credit **CubeJerry** for PR922/924 and the optimal witness, **Alluri** for PR681, **Sagar Thakrar** for PR696, **Jeremy Kothe**, **icekylinx**, **Chafik Boukhalfa** and the retained predecessor lineage. Prepared by **Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, Apache-2.0. Both checkers are AI-written; no independent human review or full theorem formalization is claimed. Inherited all-size/compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape, bit H1-H5 and analytic obligations remain.

Proof, exact histogram, source pins, validation and scope are in `research/complex-factory-scale-frontier27/`.
